summary: BTC ~$81.9k (+1.3% 24h), bounced from $81k support and ignored the 'Black Monday' anniversary scare. New today: Germany's Sparkassen began rolling out BTC trading in their banking apps (5 banks first, 30-40 more a month), Visa and Mesh launched direct crypto spending at 175M merchants, Metaplanet's US 'Superplanet' deal was approved by shareholders, and a whale opened ~$102M of leveraged BTC longs on Hyperliquid. Offsets unchanged: third straight week of ETF outflows. BTC dominance hit 60.7%, which hurts alts more than BTC. Slightly more positive than midday.
catalyst_note: Sparkassen crypto trading rollout began 19 Oct; Visa-Mesh crypto spending announced 19 Oct; Superplanet (Metaplanet) shareholder approval 16 Oct
